behaviorHardened: Enterprise-shaped inline operation receipts with operationId/actionSlot now require traceId before the main teaching workspace can show a success message.
When traceId is missing, the UI shows the audit-readback failure message instead of applying the verified local course-settings patch.
The inline audit status is marked failed, so the teacher does not receive a rollback-ready verified audit card for an untraceable save.
Existing successful inline flows with trace-backed audit readback continue to pass.
